definitions.explanation: Occurring once every two weeks. Used for schedules, publications, and recurring events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔週|かくしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Meetings are held every other week.

examples.japanese: {隔週|かくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レッスン→レッスン：01542_ressun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have piano lessons every other Friday.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔週|かくしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、{次号|じごう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: This magazine is published biweekly, and the next issue is scheduled to arrive next Tuesday.

notes:
USAGE:
{隔週|かくしゅう} uses the prefix {隔|かく} meaning "every other" or "alternate." It functions as a noun or adverbial modifier.

RELATED PATTERNS:
- {隔週|かくしゅう} (every other week)
- ⟦{隔月|かくげつ}→隔月：19328_kakugetsu⟧ (every other month)
- ⟦{隔日|かくじつ}→隔日：16891_kakujitsu⟧ (every other day)
- ⟦{隔年|かくねん}→隔年：19987_kakunen⟧ (every other year)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔週|かくしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (biweekly, every other week)
- {隔週|かくしゅう}⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧ (biweekly publication)
- {隔週|かくしゅう}{刊|かん} (biweekly periodical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {隔週|かくしゅう}: every other week (precise, specific interval)
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧: every week, weekly
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧: twice a month (similar but not identical)
